name: shure-wireless (EXPERIMENTAL FORK)
description: EXPERIMENTAL community fork of the Shure Wireless module. AD4D, AD4Q and ANX4 run on an ACN driver tested on real hardware; also adds PSM1000 and SLX-D+ and various fixes not present in the officially bundled module. Not affiliated with or supported by Bitfocus or Shure. Use a distinct version/prerelease build to avoid being confused with the bundled release.
